violation_type.title: Orientation Requirements for Caregivers-Physical Premises Safety and Protection from Hazards (26 TAC §747.1301(13))
violation_type.short_title: Orientation Requirements for Caregivers-Physical Premises Safety and Protection from Hazards
violation_type.typical_finding: The permit holders training record was monitored and missing the following orientation training. 1. Understanding building and physical premises safety, including identification and protection from hazards that can cause bodily injury such as electrical hazards, bodies of water, and vehicular traffic.   2.Handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials
